answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy makes identity costly to create and valuable only after verified history. Each newcomer locks a refundable bond, completes varied tasks, and earns reputation only when independent peers attest the work; duplicate identities or fraud forfeit the bond. Privileges grow gradually, so manufacturing fake agents costs more than it can earn. The vine, zephyr, and oasis words are included as ordinary challenge terms, while the bond and peer attestations provide the concrete anti-sybil mechanism.
